basic_info.description: This elegant Richmond home checks every box: classic curb appeal, timeless details, and thoughtful updates throughout. A formal entry opens to gracious living and dining rooms with bay windows, a fireplace, and gleaming hardwood floors. The expanded kitchen features generous counter space, a bright breakfast area, and a cozy family room that flows out to a wide deckperfect for indoor/outdoor living. The lush, landscaped garden below offers privacy and serenity. Upstairs, an elegant staircase leads to a spacious primary suite with abundant closet space and en-suite bath. Two additional bedrooms share a split bath on the landing, while a rear sunroom/bedroom offers flexibility for guests, office, or play. Great natural light, a large garage with a workshop area, and classic San Francisco charm at every turn. Located on a picturesque, tree-lined block with easy access to Clement Street's shops and restaurants, Golden Gate Park, playgrounds, schools, and transit this is the one you've been waiting for.
